programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: Thomas and Percy have a difficult delivery - getting eggs and other cake ingredients safely to Vicarstown for their bake-off.

programs.title: Play School: Down At The Beach
programs.desc: There are lots of jobs to do at the beach! Emma and Eddie are joined by special guest Surf Life Savers, Chelsea, Courtney and helpful Nipper Big Ted. They tell the story of Sally's Sunhat Saga and discover jobs at the beach.

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: Mandy and Sarah are making a film comparing dogs and cats, and the cats are clearly winning until a kitchen fire gives Nipper a chance to shine!

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy feels frustrated when Melanie is guessing all the clues in Daddy's treasure hunt and winning the prizes. So when Miffy has a chance to peek at the answers, she does.

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: Ellie sees a funny grey cloud in the sky and the Woohoos wonder, is it grey because it's grumpy? After they observe it getting bigger and darker then seeming to cry, they work out that it's grey because it's a rain cloud.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Fairy Godbrothers
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay become Fairy Godbrothers to help Nana and Amma go to see their favourite band together! Can they overcome all the obstacles in their way?

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: When Daniel is feeling a little nervous for his first trip to the hospital, Mum and Dad Tiger prepare him for his new experience. After he arrives, Daniel meets a doctor and nurse who put him at ease and help him get better.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Pants hurt his paw and can't play. Mittens and Petunia decide to make him a care package - a box with all the things he likes. But Mittens doesn't know what to put in it.

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo and BaBa find a moth and are surprised that it sleeps during the day and comes out to play at night. The Yummies find more ways to help the friends learn about nocturnal life.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: The Mixmups go on an adventure to enter a talent show and see who is the most talented.

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: Eddie finds school breaktime overwhelming with so much to choose from. He starts with familiar building blocks before joining in a fun game of tag.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything - bananas, campfires, even a snake! But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.
